title: CAD Wgpu Premigration Parity
description: Restore CAD premigration feature set inside wgpu/Rust plugin stack per plan cad_wgpu_premigration_parity_85c19a7c.
summary:
Fixed three root-cause bugs blocking CAD construction interactions and structure-classic curve rendering.

**Bug A — pointer dispatch:** Moved `engagementSessionActive` handling ahead of the `event.target === hostRef` gate in `world-3d-host.tsx` so canvas clicks during box construction reach `worldPointerDown`.

**Bug B — engagement preview:** Added dedicated `engagement_preview_json` field to `World3dScene` (core, plugin, infinite world, wgpu validation, os-shell type). CAD plugin now routes `preview_display_items` into that slot. Added `EngagementPreviewLayer` in `world-3d-host.tsx` for point/segment/box-preview geometry.

**Bug C — curve tubes:** Rewrote `curve_mesh_from_wire` to build a polygon face profile and `sweep_sync` along the wire path instead of piping a bare curve entity.

**Tests:** `sweep_wire_profile_produces_tube_mesh` in kernel_3d_brepkit; `forest_structure_curve_wires_tessellate_as_tubes` in geometry_import.rs; extended react test for `engagementPreviewJson`.

**Verification:** kernel_3d_brepkit 14/14, react 22/22, cad-plugin wasm release build OK; browser smoke on :6020 — forest example loads 11 structure-classic objects, Box tool reaches `first_corner`.
